failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS year,
    COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  m17.month,
  m17.order_cnt AS orders_2017,
  m18.order_cnt AS orders_2018,
  m18.order_cnt - m17.order_cnt AS growth_count,
  ROUND((m18.order_cnt - m17.order_cnt)::numeric / NULLIF(m17.order_cnt, 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_rate_pct
FROM monthly m17
JOIN monthly m18
  ON m18.month = m17.month
 AND m18.year = 2018
WHERE m17.year = 2017
ORDER BY m17.month
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 每个优惠券活动带来的有效订单数和商品销售额是多少？取前 10。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.campaign_id,
       c.campaign_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oc.order_id) AS valid_orders,
       SUM(os.sales) AS sales_amount
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT cu.order_id, cp.campaign_id
    FROM coupon_usages cu
    JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
) oc
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = oc.campaign_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oc.order_id
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS sales
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) os ON os.order_id = oc.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name
ORDER BY valid_orders DESC, sales_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

       SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv_with_freight,

failures.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2017,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END), 2) AS yoy_growth
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12
